name: Taj Mod
summary: Taj Mod is a fan-made reimagining of SCP:SL built on its 8.0.1 Revision III version or "Megapatch 1". It's a culmination of SCP: Secret Lab over the years including things from the past and present, as well as adding some long requested features like crouching and a variety of Human models! Taj Mod will also support a wide array of server customization for Server Hosts. With changeable LCZ Labels on release and LCZ/EZ Colors later on alongside Custom Classes. So whether you want a classic vibe with the return of the P90 and Femur Breaker, or a breath of fresh air with new consistent rooms and beautiful lighting + effects, Taj Mod has something for you... Can also be pronounced as "Tai"!
